control_flow: followInTheDark: if the right light sensor is below 60 (dim): if the line tracker is below 90 curve left 15/35, else if above 95 curve right 35/15, else call avoidWalls; if bright, call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if the left light sensor is below 70 (dim): if an obstacle is on the left turn right 20°, else if on the right turn left 20°, else call driveInTheDark; if bright, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light sensor is below 70 (dim) drive forward at 30 %, else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead stop, else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve left 10/40, else curve right 40/10.

uncertainties: You said 'drive straight where there is no line', but on the plain peach floor inside a tunnel the line tracker reads about 83, below 90, so the robot curves left as if on black; it only drives straight through a brief in-between reading (90–95).
The wall-turning branches are reached only through that brief 90–95 reading, so the robot practically never uses them.
While following a line in the dark the line tracker crosses 90–95 for a moment on each pass, so the robot briefly switches into the wall check and the straight drive, which can make it wobble.
You didn't say what the robot should do at a wall; the program stops when a wall is directly in front, only in the light.
